# ERP Sales — Sales Management Platform

> ERP Sales is a sales management platform for field teams and back-office operations. Manage customers, outlets, sales orders, visits, approvals, and real-time insights in one platform.

## Key Pages

- [Home](https://erp-sales.app/) — Platform overview, features, and demo access
- [Features](https://erp-sales.app/#features) — All 12 modules: Regions, Areas, Customers, Outlets, SKUs, Sales Orders, Visit Logs, Action Programs, Event Proposals, Email CRM, Knowledge Base, AI Admin
- [How It Works](https://erp-sales.app/#how-it-works) — 4-step workflow from setup to insight
- [FAQ](https://erp-sales.app/#faq) — Frequently asked questions about the platform
- [Contact](https://erp-sales.app/#contact) — Get in touch for custom ERP solutions
- [Sign In](https://erp-sales.app/login) — Access the demo platform

## API

- tRPC endpoint: `https://erp-sales.app/trpc`
- Full TypeScript typesafe API for all sales management operations

## Modules

- **Regions & Areas** — Define your sales territory hierarchy
- **Customer & Outlet CRM** — Manage customer profiles and retail points
- **Sales Orders** — Create, propose, and approve orders with AI-assisted validation
- **Visit Logs** — Track field visits with check-in and notes
- **Action Programs & Events** — Plan promotions with budgets and PIC accountability
- **Email Concierge** — Inbound email becomes AI-written HTML replies with optional draft orders
- **Knowledge Base** — Self-service docs grounded in your content via RAG
- **AI Admin** — Streaming LLM assistant for navigation, drafting, and data queries
- **Users & Access** — Role-based access control with granular permissions

## Structured Data

The site includes JSON-LD structured data for WebSite, FAQPage, HowTo, SoftwareApplication, and Person schemas.
